SET_R.decision: A realised SET_R <= 180 is NOT by itself a conformance failure.
SET_R.basis: R3 already distinguishes expected denominators from binding Section-E rules. A corpus meeting every minimum and violating no maximum is conformant whatever its document count.
whatThisDoesNotDo: it does not lower the >=100 gold UNIT_PAGE minimum
it does not relax the 4-pages-per-organisation SET_R cap
it does not change any Section-E rule
it does not alter a single R3 byte
it does not create an R4
SET_R.residualRiskAcknowledgedNotResolved: Plan finding2 (GOLD_UNIT_PAGE_MINIMUM_DEMANDS_UNMEASURED_ENRICHMENT) stands unchanged: with SET_R at most 180 and at least 100 gold UNIT_PAGE required, SET_R must realise a gold UNIT_PAGE share of at least 55.6%, an enrichment factor of at least 3.17x over R3's carried 0.175 planning assumption, and the Track A/B ruleset's realised enrichment factor has never been measured. This interpretation does not make that risk smaller; it only establishes that a realised SET_R of at most 180 is not itself the failure.
